blurb: Guests can cruise, paddle, or pedal down the Kanawha River enjoying skyline views and local wildlife. Offerings include guided river tours, pontoon rentals, kayak and paddleboard rentals, and e-bike rentals. The business emphasizes safety with a full walkthrough before launch and provides all required U.S. Coast Guard safety equipment.
extraNote: Consumption by the operator is prohibited · Driver must remain sober at all times · Monitors local weather and river conditions; will cancel if unsafe conditions occur · Three drop-off and pickup locations: Charleston Coliseum, University of Charleston, Haddad Riverfront Park
